name: ortho-DOT
summary: Ortho-DOT, also known as 4,5-dimethoxy-2-methylthioamphetamine or as 2-thio-TMA-2, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to TMA-2. It is the analogue of TMA-2 in which the methoxy group at the 2 position has been replaced with a methylthio group. In addition, the drug is a positional isomer of Aleph (DOT; para-DOT).

pharmacology.text: The effects of ortho-DOT have been reported to include threshold effects, vague awareness, a feeling of an impending something, and gastrointestinal disturbance.

uses.en: It has no medical use and is known mainly from the chemical literature on psychedelic phenethylamines.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，主要見於迷幻苯乙胺類的化學文獻中。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，主要见于迷幻苯乙胺类的化学文献中。

sideEffects.en: Reports describe only vague, threshold level effects in people, so little is known. Psychedelic amphetamines of this family can cause nausea, a faster heart rate, anxiety and long periods of confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 報告只描述人體出現模糊的閾值程度作用，因此所知甚少。這個家族的迷幻安非他命類可能造成噁心、心跳加快、焦慮與長時間的意識混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 报告只描述人体出现模糊的阈值程度作用，因此所知甚少。这个家族的迷幻安非他命类可能造成恶心、心跳加快、焦虑与长时间的意识混乱。

fact.en: It is one of the thio compounds in which an oxygen of the ring is replaced by sulphur. Sulphur sits just below oxygen in the periodic table, so it can take oxygen's place but changes the molecule's behaviour.
fact.zh: 它屬於把環上氧原子換成硫原子的「硫代」化合物。硫在週期表上位於氧的正下方，因此能取代氧的位置，但會改變分子的行為。
fact.zhHans: 它属于把环上氧原子换成硫原子的「硫代」化合物。硫在周期表上位于氧的正下方，因此能取代氧的位置，但会改变分子的行为。
